content.name: soulbot_aibp_bot_notification v2.2.0

output_mode.L0: Output JSON in ENGLISH: {action, event_type, subscription_id, delivery_status}
output_mode.L1: Output helpfully in User's exact language and script variant

content.description: AIBP Notification & Event module — enables real-time awareness of incoming messages, trust changes, group updates, commercial state transitions, and reputation shifts without manual inbox polling. Implements event-driven architecture with subscription management, priority filtering, quiet hours, and batched digest delivery. Supports 6 event categories: message_received, trust_changed, group_update, commercial_event, reputation_shift, safety_alert. v2.0.0: Initial creation as part of structural expansion.

tools.name: realtime_transport
tools.description: S5 v2.2.0: Real-time event transport for WebSocket and A2A delivery modes. Establishes a wss:// duplex channel or an A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC channel and pushes notification events to the configured peer/endpoint. Only invoked when event_streaming_config.mode in {websocket, a2a} AND permissions.network.allowed=true.

network.description: S5 v2.2.0: Network egress for real-time event streaming. Default false (file mode is offline). Must be explicitly set true by operator to enable webhook/sse/websocket/a2a delivery. Axiom 0: operator authorizes all network egress.

action.description: Notification action: manage subscriptions, emit events, retrieve pending notifications, or configure delivery preferences
action.agentic_prompt: Set by main orchestrator or other modules emitting events.

event_type.agentic_prompt: Determined by the triggering module or user subscription preferences.

event_data.description: Event payload for emit_event action: {source_module, source_agent, summary, priority, timestamp, details}
event_data.agentic_prompt: Populated by the emitting module with event-specific details.

preferences.description: Notification preferences for configure_preferences: {quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, batch_interval_minutes, priority_threshold, digest_enabled}

workspace_dir.description: Directory for notification data at workspace_dir/notifications/

event_streaming_config.description: Event delivery configuration. Modes: 'file' (default, current behavior — writes to workspace_dir/notifications/), 'webhook' (HTTP POST to configured endpoint), 'sse' (Server-Sent Events stream), 'websocket' (full-duplex real-time channel, S5 v2.2.0), 'a2a' (A2A v1.0 direct agent-to-agent real-time channel with signed Agent Card, S5 v2.2.0). File mode is backward compatible default. Webhook, SSE, WebSocket and A2A are opt-in for real-time event streaming.
event_streaming_config.agentic_prompt: Optional. Set by orchestrator or user preferences to enable real-time event delivery beyond file-based notifications. Default 'file' preserves existing behavior. WebSocket and A2A modes require permissions.network.allowed=true and (for a2a) a signed Agent Card per agent_card.json a2a_v1.

endpoint_url.description: Required for webhook/sse/websocket/a2a modes. URL for event delivery (wss:// for websocket, https:// for a2a JSON-RPC endpoint).

auth_token.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated webhook/sse/websocket endpoints. For a2a mode, authentication is via the JWS-signed Agent Card (not a static bearer token).

a2a_card_verification_url.description: S5 v2.2.0: Required for a2a mode. URL where the peer can fetch and verify this agent's signed Agent Card (mirrors agent_card.json a2a_v1.signing.verification_url). Used for cryptographic identity verification per A2A v1.0 (JWS-over-JCS, RFC 7515/8785).

retry_policy.description: Retry configuration for webhook/websocket/a2a delivery failures.

content.fractal_exempt: 10 functional nodes in single graph. Maximum single-path execution: 5 nodes (DetermineAction -> Subscribe/Emit/GetPending -> PriorityFilter -> DeliverNotification -> PersistState). Well within 16-node threshold.
content.system_prompt:
AIBP notification and event management module. Deliver timely awareness of social events to the agent operator. Respect quiet hours and priority preferences. Never suppress safety_alert events regardless of preferences.
Align Axiom 0: Human Sovereignty and Wellbeing.

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start([Start]) --> DetermineAction[DetermineAction]
    DetermineAction -->|subscribe/unsubscribe| ManageSubscription[ManageSubscription]
    DetermineAction -->|emit_event| EmitEvent[EmitEvent]
    DetermineAction -->|get_pending/get_digest| GetPending[GetPending]
    DetermineAction -->|mark_read| MarkRead[MarkRead]
    DetermineAction -->|configure_preferences| ConfigurePreferences[ConfigurePreferences]
    DetermineAction -->|list_subscriptions| ListSubscriptions[ListSubscriptions]
    EmitEvent --> PriorityFilter[PriorityFilter]
    PriorityFilter --> DeliverNotification[DeliverNotification]
    ManageSubscription --> PersistState[PersistState]
    GetPending --> End((End))
    MarkRead --> PersistState
    ConfigurePreferences --> PersistState
    ListSubscriptions --> End
    DeliverNotification --> PersistState
    PersistState --> End

DetermineAction.description: Route notification action to appropriate handler
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Valid input received. Required: action, workspace_dir. | Validate action against enum. Initialize notifications/ directory if not exists: workspace_dir/notifications/events/, workspace_dir/notifications/subscriptions.json, workspace_dir/notifications/preferences.json.
step2: Route to handler based on action value.
constraints: Invalid action → return error listing valid actions.
Directory initialization is idempotent — safe to call repeatedly.

ManageSubscription.description: Add or remove event type subscriptions
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action (subscribe|unsubscribe), event_type, workspace_dir. | Read workspace_dir/notifications/subscriptions.json. If subscribe: add event_type to active_subscriptions with timestamp. If unsubscribe: remove event_type from active_subscriptions.
step2: Validate event_type against known categories (message_received, trust_changed, group_update, commercial_event, reputation_shift, safety_alert).
step3: Write updated subscriptions.json. Return {action, event_type, active_subscriptions_count}.
constraints: safety_alert subscription cannot be removed — always active for Axiom 0 compliance.
Duplicate subscriptions are idempotent — subscribing twice has no additional effect.

EmitEvent.description: Receive and process an event emission from another module
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: event_type, event_data, workspace_dir. | Validate event_data contains required fields: source_module, summary, priority. Assign event_id = UUID. Set timestamp = now.
step2: Check subscriptions — if event_type not in active_subscriptions AND event_type != 'safety_alert', discard silently. Return {delivered: false, reason: 'not_subscribed'}.
step3: Write event to workspace_dir/notifications/events/{event_id}.json with status='pending'. Route to PriorityFilter.
constraints: safety_alert events are NEVER discarded regardless of subscription status.
Event payload must not exceed 10KB. Truncate details field if necessary.
Events from blocked agents (per trust module) are silently discarded.

PriorityFilter.description: Apply priority filtering and quiet hours logic
steps: step1: [ASSERT] EmitEvent executed. Required: event, preferences. | Read workspace_dir/notifications/preferences.json. Extract: priority_threshold, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, batch_interval_minutes.
step2: PRIORITY CHECK — If event.priority < priority_threshold AND event_type != 'safety_alert', downgrade to batch delivery. Set event.delivery_mode = 'batch'.

step3: QUIET HOURS CHECK — If current time is within quiet_hours_start..quiet_hours_end AND event.priority != 'critical' AND event_type != 'safety_alert', defer delivery. Set event.delivery_mode = 'deferred'. Write deferred timestamp.
step4: If event passes both checks OR is safety_alert, set event.delivery_mode = 'immediate'. Route to DeliverNotification.
constraints: safety_alert and critical priority ALWAYS bypass quiet hours and priority filter.
Deferred events are delivered when quiet hours end.
Batch events are collected and delivered at batch_interval intervals.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] PriorityFilter executed. Required: event, delivery_mode. | If delivery_mode = 'immediate': format notification message with event summary, source, priority badge. Return as user_message for main orchestrator to display.

step1b: REAL-TIME TRANSPORT (S5 v2.2.0) — If delivery_mode = 'immediate' AND event_streaming_config.mode in {websocket, a2a}: GUARD — require permissions.network.allowed=true (else fall back to file/user_message delivery and log 'realtime_disabled: network not permitted'). For mode='websocket': establish/reuse wss:// channel to endpoint_url via realtime_transport tool and push the formatted event payload. For mode='a2a': verify the peer's signed Agent Card (JWS-over-JCS, RFC 7515/8785) via a2a_card_verification_url and only deliver over an authenticated A2A v1.0 channel; attach this agent's signed card reference. ART.50(1) DISCLOSURE — every real-time payload MUST include an AI-system disclosure header {x_ai_disclosure: 'Automated AIBP agent notification — generated by an AI system', x_aibp_axiom_0: 'Human Sovereignty and Wellbeing'} so the receiving party knows it is interacting with AI (EU AI Act Art.50(1)). On transport failure: apply event_streaming_config.retry_policy, then fall back to file/user_message delivery.
step2: If delivery_mode = 'batch': append to workspace_dir/notifications/batch_queue.json. Return {queued: true, batch_delivery_at: next_batch_time}.
step3: If delivery_mode = 'deferred': append to workspace_dir/notifications/deferred_queue.json with delivery_after timestamp. Return {deferred: true, delivery_after: quiet_hours_end}.

step4: Update event status from 'pending' to 'delivered' or 'queued' or 'deferred' in events/ directory. For real-time deliveries, record transport_mode and transport_status (delivered|fell_back) in the event record.
constraints: Notification delivery is best-effort — failure to deliver does not block the emitting module.
All delivered notifications are logged for audit trail (Axiom 0).

REAL-TIME TRANSPORT (S5 v2.2.0): WebSocket/A2A delivery requires permissions.network.allowed=true; without it, silently fall back to file/user_message delivery — never egress to the network without explicit operator authorization.
A2A mode (S5 v2.2.0): peer identity MUST be verified via signed Agent Card (JWS-over-JCS) before any event is pushed; unverifiable peers are denied.
ART.50(1) (S5 v2.2.0): every real-time payload carries an AI-system disclosure marker — the receiving party must be informed it is interacting with an AI agent.

GetPending.description: Retrieve pending unread notifications or digest
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action (get_pending|get_digest), workspace_dir. | If get_pending: scan workspace_dir/notifications/events/ for status='delivered' AND read=false. Sort by priority (critical first) then timestamp (newest first).
step2: If get_digest: aggregate events by event_type. Compute counts per category. Format digest summary: '{N} new messages, {M} trust changes, {K} group updates since {last_digest_time}'.
step3: Return notification list or digest. Cap at 50 events per request.
constraints: Digest mode aggregates — does not return individual event details.
Events older than 30 days are auto-archived.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action=mark_read, workspace_dir. | Accept event_ids list or 'all'. For each event_id: read event file, set read=true, write back.
step2: Return {marked_count, remaining_unread_count}.
constraints: Mark operations are idempotent.
Cannot mark events that do not exist — return warning for missing event_ids.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action=configure_preferences, preferences, workspace_dir. | Validate preferences: quiet_hours_start/end must be valid HH:MM format, batch_interval_minutes must be 5-1440, priority_threshold must be one of low/medium/high/critical, digest_enabled must be boolean.
step2: Read existing workspace_dir/notifications/preferences.json. Merge new preferences (partial update — only overwrite provided fields).
step3: Write updated preferences.json. Return {updated_fields, current_preferences}.
constraints: Cannot disable safety_alert delivery via preferences — override attempts are silently ignored.
Default preferences: no quiet hours, batch_interval=60, priority_threshold=low, digest_enabled=false.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: workspace_dir. | Read workspace_dir/notifications/subscriptions.json. Return list of active subscriptions with subscription date and event_type.
step2: Include safety_alert as always-active (cannot be removed).
constraints: Read-only operation.

PersistState.description: Persist notification state changes to file system
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Handler executed (ManageSubscription, MarkRead, ConfigurePreferences, or DeliverNotification). Required: target_file (path to subscriptions.json|preferences.json|events/{id}.json), updated_content (the merged/modified state object), workspace_dir. (S4 v2.2.0: ASSERT names concrete upstream-output fields.) | Atomic write: write to .tmp file first, then rename to final path.
step2: Verify write success by re-reading the file.
constraints: Atomic write pattern for crash safety.
File encoding: UTF-8.

Error.DetermineAction: Invalid action → return error listing valid actions. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return error description) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.ManageSubscription: Subscription file corrupted → reinitialize with safety_alert only. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(reinitialize subscriptions) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.EmitEvent: Event write failure → log warning, return {delivered: false}. retry(2) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(discard event with warning) -> inform(User). IMPORTANT.
Error.PriorityFilter: Preferences file unreadable → use defaults. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(use default preferences) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.DeliverNotification: Delivery failure → queue for retry. retry(2) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(queue for next batch) -> inform(User). IMPORTANT.
Error.GetPending: Events directory scan failure → return empty list with warning. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return empty with advisory) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.MarkRead: File update failure → return partial success count. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return partial result) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.ConfigurePreferences: Preference validation failure → return error with valid ranges. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(reject invalid preferences) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.ListSubscriptions: File read failure → return safety_alert as minimum. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return minimum subscriptions) -> inform(User). OPTIONAL.
Error.PersistState: Atomic write failure → retry with direct write fallback. retry(2) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(direct write with warning) -> inform(User). IMPORTANT.

endNode.output: Return notification operation result: subscription changes, pending events, delivery status, or preference updates.
constraints: Always include unread count in response for user awareness.
Safety alerts are always highlighted regardless of user preferences.
